dedupe_keys.name: agent based hospital building evacuation in a fire with evacuee categories gama

description: This repository holds the GAML source code for a study on integrating the categorisation of evacuees into an agent-based simulation to improve evacuation of a building, a hospital, when a fire breaks out. The model runs on the GAMA platform from version 1.6, and the README explains how to import the code, set up the experiment's parameters such as the number of agents and environment settings, run it and view results in GAMA's graphs, maps and 3D views. Coverage: one hospital building model. Access: free on GitHub. Licence: a Creative Commons licence in the LICENSE file. Caveats: little documentation beyond the README; the linked paper was not read. Simulation uses are fire evacuation planning in hospitals where patients need different levels of help. Related records: the emergency department simulation and CINCH1 on CoMSES.
licence: Creative Commons licence (per the LICENSE file)
name: Agent-based hospital building evacuation in a fire with evacuee categories (GAMA)
outputs: Evacuation times and flows by evacuee category
